common.name: Name
welcome.title: Learn phones and the internet, safely.
welcome.subtitle: Voice first. Pictures. Your own language. One small step at a time.
welcome.langHint: Tap a language to hear it. You can change it later.
setup.title: Make the app comfortable for you
setup.intro: Choose what is easy for your eyes and ears. You can change this later.
setup.preview: This is how the words will look.
auth.title: Enter your phone number
auth.phoneHint: We will send you a 6-digit code. It is free.
auth.helperNote: A helper can set this up with you. You must still agree yourself.
auth.staffHint: Use the email and password given to you.
auth.invalidPhone: Please enter a correct phone number, like 0803 000 0000.
auth.invalidCode: That code is not correct. Please try again.
auth.locked: Too many tries. Please wait 15 minutes.
auth.consentIntro: I agree to use {{app}} and to the privacy notice. I understand this is a practice helper, not a bank.
goals.title: What do you want to learn first?
goals.intro: Choose one. You can learn everything later.
home.subtitle: What would you like to do today?
home.offlineNotice: You are offline. Your downloaded lessons still work.
path.title: Learning path
path.fallbackNotice: This lesson is in English for now. A reviewed translation is coming.
lesson.congrats: Well done! You finished this lesson.
lesson.audioMissing: This screen has no recorded audio yet. Tap Listen to hear the phone voice.
sandbox.title: Practice phone
sandbox.banner: This is practice. Nothing will be sent. No real money.
sandbox.hint: Hint: look at the glowing picture.
sandbox.wrong: That is not the right one. It is okay. Look at the hint and try again.
voice.title: Ask {{app}}
voice.intro: Press the big microphone and speak. Ask about phones, WhatsApp, banking or scams.
voice.confirmYes: Yes, that is what I said
voice.offline: You are offline. You can still read the saved answers, or talk to a person.
voice.aiNotice: I am an AI helper. I can make mistakes. Never share your PIN or OTP with me.
voice.error: I could not hear that clearly. Please try again, or talk to a person.
scam.title: Is this a scam?
scam.intro: Speak, paste or type the message you received. I will check the warning signs.
scam.placeholder: Paste or type the message here
scam.noCertainty: I can be wrong. If you are not sure, ask a person you trust.
progress.title: My progress
progress.intro: Every small step counts. There is no rush.
progress.keepGoing: Keep going. You are doing well.
progress.noProgress: You have not finished a lesson yet. Your first one is waiting.
me.title: Me
me.deleteConfirm: This will delete your account and progress. This cannot be undone. Are you sure?
me.name: What should we call you?
family.title: Family link
family.intro: You can let a family member see your progress. They cannot see your private messages or voice unless you allow it. You can stop this at any time.
family.invited: Invitation saved. Ask them to log in and accept.
family.consentNeeded: You must agree before a family member can see your progress.
family.scopeAlerts: Receive alerts when I check a scam
family.pending: Waiting for the family member to accept
family.none: No family member is linked yet.
facilitator.title: Facilitator dashboard
facilitator.csvHint: One learner per line: name,phone. Example: Ada,08030000001
facilitator.noGroups: You have no groups yet. Create one to begin.
admin.title: Admin
privacy.title: Privacy and my data
privacy.intro: We collect only what we need: your name or nickname, phone, language and progress. We do not ask for your NIN, BVN or card details.
privacy.terms: I agree to the terms and privacy notice
privacy.ai: I understand the helper is an AI and can make mistakes
privacy.transcripts: Keep my voice transcripts for 30 days to improve answers
privacy.family: Allow my linked family member to see my progress
privacy.deleteWarning: This deletes your account and personal data. It cannot be undone.
privacy.exportDone: Your data file has been prepared.
privacy.retention: Voice audio is deleted immediately after it is understood, unless you allow us to keep it. Transcripts are kept for 30 days at most.
privacy.deleteDone: Your account and data have been deleted.
help.title: Talk to a person
help.intro: A facilitator or support person can call you back or message you on WhatsApp.
help.facilitator: Tell my facilitator I need help
help.sent: Your request is saved. Someone will contact you.
offline.title: Offline lessons
offline.installHint: Open your browser menu and choose Add to home screen.
translation.notice: Some words are still being checked by native speakers. English is shown where needed.
errors.network: No connection. Please try again when you have network.
certificate.title: Certificate of completion
certificate.body: for completing the {{path}} learning path on {{app}}.
app.wrongPin: Never share your PIN. This is only practice.
